  reg curr_frame_i; 
  wire ready = curr_frame_i & ~prev_frame_i; 
  assign we_o = ready; 
  reg reset; 
  assign reset_o = reset; 
  assign ptr_inc_o = reset; 
  always @(posedge sys_clk_i) begin

  curr_frame_i <= 0; 
  prev_frame_i <= 0; 
  reset <= 0;

  curr_frame_i <= frame_i; 
  prev_frame_i <= curr_frame_i; 
  reset <= we_o; 
  end 
  end
